description: This file defines the Entity Framework Core configuration for the OrderItem entity in the eShopOnWeb project. It specifies how the OrderItem properties and owned types are mapped to the database schema.

classes.name: OrderItemConfiguration
classes.description: Implements IEntityTypeConfiguration<OrderItem> to configure the database mapping for OrderItem entities.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up the entity configuration for OrderItem, including the owned ItemOrdered property and the UnitPrice property database configuration.
